LanguageData.LP_PlanarRift.label: planar rift
LanguageData.LP_PlanarRift.description: A purple-black vortex tearing through reality, with another plane on the other side. Creatures pour out of it every so often.\n\nSmash it (600 hit points), or have a genie command it to close, to shut it. A rift left open for three days collapses.
LanguageData.LP_PlanarResidue.label: planar residue
LanguageData.LP_PlanarResidue.description: Purple-glowing crystal fragments left behind when a planar rift closes, alternately cold and hot to the touch. Used at the alchemy table to enhance potions so they last twice as long.
LanguageData.LP_PotionGreaterHealingEnhanced.label: enhance greater healing potion
LanguageData.LP_PotionGreaterHealingEnhanced.descript: A greater healing potion with planar residue, glowing faintly purple. Same effect as a greater healing potion, with the faster healing duration doubled (12 hours). No effect on liches and necromantic constructs.
LanguageData.LP_PotionFireResistanceEnhanced.label: enhance fire resistance potion
LanguageData.LP_PotionFireResistanceEnhanced.descript: A fire resistance potion with planar residue, glowing faintly purple. Same effect as a fire resistance potion, with the duration doubled (48 hours).
